title: Project Setup: Install Libraries
description: Choose and install necessary libraries for numerical computation (e.g., NumPy) and plotting (e.g., Matplotlib or Plotly).

title: Signal Generation: Implement Signal Generation
description: Implement a function to generate the sine wave signal based on the specified parameters (10 cycles, 200 samples per cycle).

title: Signal Generation: Write Unit Tests
description: Write unit tests to verify the correctness of the signal generation.

title: User Interface: Create Basic UI
description: Create a basic UI to display the generated signal.

title: User Interface: Implement Segment Selection
description: Implement the functionality for the user to select a segment of the signal.

title: User Interface: Implement Snap to Sample Points
description: Ensure the selection mechanism snaps to the discrete sample points of the signal.

title: Convolution: Implement Convolution
description: Implement the convolution operation between the signal and the selected segment (kernel). Note: The convolution should be implemented in a way that the result peaks when the pattern is matched. This can be achieved by using normalized cross-correlation or by manipulating the kernel.

title: Convolution: Write Unit Tests
description: Write unit tests to verify the correctness of the convolution implementation.

title: Pattern Matching: Implement Peak Identification
description: Implement the logic to identify the peaks in the convolution output, which correspond to the matched patterns.

title: Pattern Matching: Extract Matched Pattern Indices
description: Implement a function to extract the indices of the matched patterns in the original signal.

title: Visualization: Implement Main Plot
description: Implement the visualization of the original signal, the selected pattern, and the highlighted matched patterns in a single plot.

title: Visualization: Implement Convolution Plot
description: Implement the visualization of the convolution result in a separate plot.

title: Visualization: Implement Image Save
description: Add a feature to save the visualizations as an image file (e.g., PNG).

title: Main Application: Integrate Components
description: Integrate all the components into a single application.

title: Main Application: Implement User Flow
description: Implement the main user flow: display signal, select segment, perform convolution, and display results.

title: Documentation: Add Code Comments
description: Add comments and documentation to the code.

title: Documentation: Refine UI and Visualizations
description: Refine the UI and visualizations for clarity and ease of use.

title: Documentation: Create README
description: Create a README.md file with instructions on how to run the program.
